title: Upgrade Livestreams With Twitch Enhanced Broadcasting and NVIDIA Encoder
description: At TwitchCon — a global convention for the Twitch livestreaming platform — livestreamers and content creators this week can experience the latest technologies for accelerating creative workflows and improving video quality. That includes the beta release of Twitch Enhanced Broadcasting support for NVIDIA’s HEVC codec, delivering 25% improved video quality.
